recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce CareTeam.encounter or add redundant CareTeam prose; the current model represents the approved direction by letting Encounter, EpisodeOfCare, and CarePlan reference CareTeam.
issue_request: FHIR-23029 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It originally asked to relax CareTeam.encounter from 0..1 to 0..*, but the PA/PC joint-session resolution instead voted to remove CareTeam.encounter and the EpisodeOfCare standard extension from CareTeam.
initial_application: The issue was applied by git commit 4832b70ae3ebeefb51ab800a1200207eabd0313a, which removed the encounter reference from the CareTeam example and disabled CareTeam.encounter in the then-authoritative CareTeam spreadsheet. Current source has since been refactored to StructureDefinition XML, where CareTeam.encounter is absent and source/fhir.ini records the R4/R5 map note that CareTeam.encounter was removed to avoid circular references because Encounter references CareTeam.
additional_context: FHIR-23843 is the PA-side companion issue and added Encounter.careTeam 0..* Reference(CareTeam). Current source contains that element, and the CareTeam introduction says CareTeam can be referenced by EpisodeOfCare, Encounter, or CarePlan. FHIR-32767 later added the Encounter careteam search parameter and is already represented on the combined branch by a separate source-fix commit. Exact Zulip issue-key searches found no direct hits; Confluence references for FHIR-23843 confirmed the Encounter-side follow-up.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current build-scope source already removes the reverse CareTeam link, the CareTeam example has no encounter, the workflow EpisodeOfCare extension is not used by CareTeam in core or allowed on CareTeam in the Extension Pack definition, and the inverse Encounter.careTeam relationship exists.

related_jiras.note: Companion PA issue that added Encounter.careTeam after the PC decision to remove the reverse CareTeam.encounter link.
